children: Kontoor Brands announced Helly Hansen’s growth strategy and 2030 targets, including revenue of more than $1.1 billion and $500M+ cumulative cash generation through 2030.
Announced Helly Hansen long-term plan anchored on U.S. expansion, premium outdoor and workwear to scale globally.
Set 2030 financial targets: revenue > $1.1B (CAGR ~10% from $675.1M FY25 pro‑forma).
Targeted margin goals: gross margin mid‑ to high‑50s% and operating margin in the mid‑teens% range.
Forecasts cumulative cash generation > $500M through 2030 to support earnings profile and capital allocation optionality.
Investor Day materials and slides furnished as exhibits; FY25 pro‑forma Helly Hansen revenue presented as $675.091M.
